info.title: InsightSentry API
info.description: Comprehensive financial data API providing access to global equities, indices, futures, options, cryptocurrencies, and forex markets with current and historical data.

get.description: Retrieve available trades for a symbol. Today's and tomorrow's UTC dates return a rolling snapshot, with 24 hours by default; the previous six dates return their UTC calendar days. For continuous futures, 1! uses today's front contract and 2! uses today's next contract for every requested date. The response code identifies the selected dated contract.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Today and the previous six dates are supported; tomorrow's date returns the current rolling window until UTC midnight.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Rolling duration for today's or tomorrow's UTC date. Ignored for historical dates.

get.description: List option contracts from the SIP data feed for US equities (stocks and ETFs) and supported indices only. Filter by strike, range, expiration, or type, and use next_token for further pages. Returned contract codes can be used with /v3/symbols/quotes and, where available, /v3/symbols/{symbol}/series.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: (Optional) Exact strike price. Takes precedence over range when both are provided.

parameters.name: expiration
parameters.description: (Optional) Exact expiration date. Validated but not used when from or to is provided. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: (Optional) Minimum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. For example, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of the current price. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by option type.

parameters.name: next_token
parameters.description: (Optional) Pagination token from a previous /v3/options/contracts response. Send the same filters plus next_token to request the next page.

get.summary: Option quotes by strike or expiration
get.description: Get all matching option-chain rows from the Global feed for supported stock, ETF, index, and futures underlyings. For range requests, up to 100 contracts with strikes closest to the underlying price may also include last_price, volume, open_interest, open_interest_time, change, and change_percent. Other rows retain available bid/ask, Greeks, and contract fields. Additional fields may be omitted. With no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector, range defaults to 1000. Strike takes precedence over range.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: (Optional) Strike price for exact match filtering.

parameters.name: expiration

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. When that price is available, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of it. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Ignored when strike is provided. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

Retrieve latest financial news with optional keyword and field-specific filtering

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: (Optional) Keywords to include items that match one of the keywords in the title, content, or related symbols. Values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters. e.g. apple,tesla

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose source exactly matches this value. Matching is case-insensitive. The value must contain at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

parameters.name: related_symbols
parameters.description: (Optional) Return news items that contain any matching related symbol. Values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters. Exchange-qualified values such as NASDAQ:AAPL require the full symbol; symbol-only values such as AAPL match related symbols after ignoring the exchange prefix.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose title contains these values. Matching is case-insensitive and partial; values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose content contains these values. Matching is case-insensitive and partial; values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: (Optional) Limit the number of news items returned. Must be an integer between 1 and 500. Default is 500.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination

parameters.name: archive
parameters.description: (Optional) Set to true to search older archived news when using filters. Archived results may omit very recent items.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: (Optional) UTC start date. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When provided without to, to is treated as the current UTC date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: (Optional) UTC end date. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Validated but not used when from is absent. Future dates are treated as the current UTC date.

400.description: A filter value is shorter than 3 characters.

ScreenerRequest.description: Base screener request format. Additional properties are filters only when their base name is a scalar field listed in available_fields by the matching Get Screener endpoint. A direct numeric or string field name accepts a same-type scalar equality value or a non-empty same-type array for membership. Numeric fields also accept inclusive _min and _max bounds; _range accepts exactly two numeric bounds. Collection-valued fields are selectable response fields but are not filters. Invalid filter fields or values are rejected unless ignore_invalid is true.

fields.description: Array of field names to include in the response. You can find available fields in the Get Screener endpoint. At least one field must be specified, up to 10 fields maximum.

exchanges.description: Array of exchange names to filter by (e.g., ["NYSE", "NASDAQ"]). If not specified or empty, no exchange filtering will be applied.

ignore_invalid.description: If true, invalid values from request body will be ignored instead of returning an error.

countries.description: Array of country codes to filter by (e.g., ["US", "CA"]). If not specified or empty, no country filtering will be applied.

max_range.description: Number of screener results returned per page. The minimum value of 1 is preserved; values from 2 are rounded up to the next multiple of 500. Default is 1000. Supported values: 1 - 15000.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. It should be one of supported fields. If not specified, it will sort by the symbol name.

items.description:
Time series point. The numeric value keys depend on the indicator type:
- Scalar fundamentals (e.g. `price_earnings`, `diluted_shares_outstanding_fy`): a single `close` field.
- Multi-line technical studies (e.g. `rsi`, `macd`): the study ID is itself a key (e.g. `rsi`), alongside one or more companion plot lines (e.g. `plot`, `rsi-based_ma`).
In all cases `time` is present and every non-time value is numeric.

additionalProperties.description: Numeric value for a study output line. Key name matches the study ID (e.g. `rsi`) or a companion plot line (e.g. `plot`, `rsi-based_ma`).

BarIntervalParam.name: bar_interval
BarIntervalParam.description: Bar interval. Default is 1; unsupported values use 1.

SipBarIntervalParam.name: bar_interval
SipBarIntervalParam.description: Bar interval. Tick and second bars use 1.

ExtendedParam.name: extended
ExtendedParam.description: (Optional) Extended hours (Not all assets support extended hours). Default to true.

TwentyFourHourParam.name: 24h
TwentyFourHourParam.description: (Optional) Request 24-hour market data. Only NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, and CBOE are supported; other exchanges ignore this parameter. When true, takes precedence over extended. Default is false.

SplitAdjustmentParam.name: split
SplitAdjustmentParam.description: (Optional) Split adjustment for equities and ETFs. Default to true. When false, returns unadjusted data and overrides dadj.

DividendAdjustmentParam.name: dadj
DividendAdjustmentParam.description: (Optional) Dividend adjustment for equities and etfs (has no effect on assets without dividends). Only applies when split=true. Default to false.

BackAdjustmentParam.name: badj
BackAdjustmentParam.description: (Optional) Back-adjustment for continous futures contracts (has no effect on non-continous futures data). Default to true.

CurrencyParam.name: currency
CurrencyParam.description: (Optional) Convert the OHLCV data to a different currency. The currency code must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Do not include this field if you want to use the default currency for the symbol

SettlementParam.name: settlement
SettlementParam.description: (Optional) Set Settlement as daily close. Default is false

WeekRangeParam.name: w
WeekRangeParam.description: Specifies the week range. For example, 1 means this week (starting today) through next week, 2 means next week through the following week, and so on. When provided, this parameter takes precedence over month.

CalendarMonthParam.name: month
CalendarMonthParam.description: Fetches one historical UTC calendar month in YYYY-MM format when w is absent. Invalid months are rejected even when w is provided. The current or a future month is rejected. Oldest available months are 2012-12 for events, 2025-01 for dividends, 2012-04 for earnings, and 1995-01 for IPOs.

CountryCodeParam.name: c
CountryCodeParam.description: (Optional) Filter by country code(s) as a comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 string, for example `US,AR`. Invalid codes will be ignored.

CalendarCodeParam.name: code
CalendarCodeParam.description: (Optional) Filter by symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Returns only calendar entries matching this symbol.

CalendarLocalCurrencyParam.name: local
CalendarLocalCurrencyParam.description: When true and `c` contains exactly one supported non-US country code, monetary values are returned in that country's local reporting currency. Otherwise, the default reporting currency is used.

DataPointsParam.name: dp
DataPointsParam.description: The minimum value of 1 is preserved; values from 2 are rounded up to the next multiple of 500 data points. Default is 3000. Supported values: 1 - 30000.

AbbrParam.name: abbr
AbbrParam.description: Set to true to return series as arrays with a series_keys array of field names. Empty series may omit series_keys.

bearerAuth.description: Obtain Bearer token from the Dashboard. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {token}'
